Seeff Hibiscus Coast is situated along the sunny coastline of the Kwa Zulu Natal South Coast. The Hibiscus Coast is renowned for its colorful trees, sprawling beaches, great golf courses and nature reserves.

Seeff Hibiscus Coast is located in St Michaels on Sea and has been in operation since August 2018, headed up by Michelle Harris, who is the Sole Director & Principal. The professional team of Property Practitioners offer a wide range of properties for sale and rent.

The branch focuses on selling properties from Mtwalume along the south coast to Port Edward. Selling and renting of property whether it be residential or commercial, we also offer valuations, dominance on the leading property portals as well as our seeff.com website that attracts unique potential property buyers each month along with a sophisticated referral system.

Our exclusive partnership with Hamptons International provides access to a network of offices across the United Kingdom and Europe, giving us access to an international audience of potential buyers and sellers.

We want to help you prosper through property with our Seeff area specialists who are dedicated, experienced, enthusiastic

and who have built a reputation for quality service. Our team has won a number of awards from Marketer of the Year, OOBA most referrals and Licensee of the Year!

Seeff is a trusted brand in the property industry and we give you the best service embodied with our values of

? Excellence

"Home is our story which we align with all our values"
